title: Appearance
description: How your menu looks to guests. Changes show in the preview right away; guests see them after you save.
themes_hint: Start from a ready-made look, then adjust it.
contrast_light: This colour is hard to read on white. Guests will see a darker shade of it so the text stays readable.

editorial.name: A · Warm editorial
editorial.hint: Big photos first and serif headings, like a printed café menu.

grid.name: B · Fresh grid
grid.hint: Your name on the banner and two photo cards per row, like a food app.

bistro.name: C · Quiet bistro
bistro.hint: A calm list with small photos on the right. Quickest to scan.

minimal.name: D · Minimal
minimal.hint: Text only: names, short descriptions and prices. No dish photos. Fastest.

mesob.name: E · Mesob
mesob.hint: Warm colours, woven bands and round photos. Made for Ethiopian and Somali food.

lounge.name: F · Night Lounge
lounge.hint: Always dark, with a soft glow in your colour. For bars, lounges and late nights.

board.name: G · Street Board
board.hint: A clean chalkboard with price tags. For fast food, burgers and juice bars.

arabic.name: H · Arabic
arabic.hint: Kufi headings, gold ornaments and your colour as a band. Right-to-left for Arabic menus. For Arabic, Yemeni and Middle Eastern food.

islamic.name: I · Islamic
islamic.hint: Star patterns, an arch at the top and arched photos. Optional Halal badge and Ramadan mode. For halal and family restaurants.

somali.name: J · Somali
somali.hint: Ocean blues, woven-basket bands and waves. For Somali restaurants and cafés.

mono.name: K · Black & White
mono.hint: Only black, white and greys, big type and fine lines. Light or dark like the guest's phone. For modern cafés and fine dining.

colour.name: L · Colourful
colour.hint: A bright colour for each category, made from your colour, and rounded cards. For juice bars, ice cream and family places.

coffee.name: M · Coffee House
coffee.hint: A dark-roast band with a jebena and cups, round photos, coffee-bean marks. For coffee houses, cafés and tea rooms.

grill.name: N · Grill & BBQ
grill.hint: Charcoal and embers, flames, tall bold headings, price tags. For tibs, kitfo and grill houses, nyama choma, burgers and steaks.

garden.name: O · Garden Fresh
garden.hint: Leaves and soft greens, white rounded cards. For juice houses, salad bars, healthy cafés and fasting menus.

coastal.name: P · Coastal
coastal.hint: A deep-sea band with a dhow, sand and coral, ticket-like cards. For fish and seafood places by the sea.

luxe.name: Q · Fine Dining
luxe.hint: Marble, thin gold lines, an elegant serif, centred headings. For hotels, fine dining and events.

flags.show_order_list: Show "Add to my order" (+) buttons on my menu
flags.show_other_branches: Show "Other branches" at the bottom of the menu (only with more than one branch)
flags.show_order_list_hint: Guests tap + to note dishes on their own phone, then show the list to the waiter. Nothing is sent to you. Off: no + buttons and no list, your menu looks just as clean.

direction_hint: Right-to-left puts the text and buttons on the right side, for Arabic menus.

style_flags.show_halal_hint: A small badge under your restaurant's name. Turn it on only if all your food is halal.
style_flags.ramadan_mode_hint: A night-sky top with a crescent. Turn it off again after Ramadan.
style_flags.photos_greyscale_hint: Shows your dish photos and banner in black and white.
style_flags.mono_accent: Use your brand colour as a small accent
style_flags.mono_accent_hint: Your colour on the "+" buttons, badges and the chosen category. Prices keep the text colour.
style_flags.show_decoration: Show the style's pictures and icons
style_flags.show_decoration_hint: The header picture, textures and category icons. Your banner replaces the header picture; a category photo (Menu editor) replaces its icon.

images_hint: The banner is the wide photo at the top of your menu. It is cropped to the shape your menu style uses.
saved: Appearance saved. Guests see it now.
preview_hint: Preview of your menu on a phone (not saved yet).
preview_desktop_hint: Your menu as a computer shows it, with the changes you haven't saved yet.
